purpose: What three reviews of 2026-11-25 found missing from the records of the dense TinyLlama proposal, and the reruns after the fixes that followed them. No GPU and no paid service was used for anything recorded here. The changes that this and earlier commits made in place to earlier evidence files are listed, with the values they removed

commit.note: the head of all six reruns. Later commits change records, comments, tests, the sweep script and the worker (its check that expected.sha256 names five files compares whole names); the gates name their own commit

made_by: the contributor's AI-assisted sessions, on the contributor's laptop (macOS arm64) and on a Linux x86_64 host of the contributor's; no independent reviewer

authority.statement: The GPU run of 2026-11-24 and 25 was paid by the contributor on the contributor's own RunPod account, with no owner-set cap. Issue #184 says that paid GPU runs need an owner-approved budget, issue #186 puts unbudgeted GPU runs out of scope, docs/OPERATIONS.md says to stop before a paid job or an upload for which no authority exists, and research/AUTHORITY.json lists Modal, Vast.ai and Hugging Face Jobs as compute providers, not RunPod. AGENTS.md says no system-package installs: on the rented pods the set-up scripts installed packages with apt-get and pip. No authority record was made or changed for the run
authority.limit_of_the_run: a watchdog on the controlling host, armed to terminate every pod of the account after 2,700 s (pod 1) and 3,600 s (pod 2); both were cancelled by hand after the pods were terminated

gpu_run_files.note: files kept from the pods of the GPU run, as the worker wrote them; the proof, key and leaf files themselves are held by the contributor and are not published

seed.note: upstream's published seed; each pod's inputs.sha256 names it
